ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund due. If the rider appeals within 30 days, handle via RydeHELP voucher channel (NS-7).

rejected_claims.reason: Ryde publishes no late-driver free-cancellation rule (NS-8 is informational and the dataset has no ETA field); NS-4 imposes no driver-distance condition, so lateness does not waive the $6.61.
NS-2 applies only when the driver cancels alleging passenger no-show; here the rider cancelled (cancelled_by = rider) and no 'I'm Here' press exists.
No RD-1 violation or RD-2 refund is established in this case, and profile facts alone cannot ground an account flag (RD-6 not triggered).
